components.description: Elevated container with gradient, top highlight, and optional header
components.html:
KPI GLOBAUX

components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(#12141c, #0d0f15); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card-highlight { height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.15), rgba(99,102,241,0.25), transparent); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-green { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.35); color: #34d399; } .ds-badge-red { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.35); color: #f87171; } .ds-badge-blue { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.12); border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.35); color: #818cf8; } .ds-badge-gold { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.35); color: #fbbf24; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gradient action button with indigo gradient
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(to right, #6366f1, #4f46e5); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Bottom Tab
components.description: Bottom navigation tab with icon and label
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 6px 0; height: 64px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tab-active span { color: #818cf8; } .ds-tab-inactive span { color: #475569; } .ds-tab span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark-themed text input with border focus
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0a0c12; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; height: 48px; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.5); } .ds-input input { background: transparent; border: none; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; outline: none; width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Seven Journal is a data-dense, dark-mode-first trading terminal designed for quantitative traders. Every screen feels like a Bloomberg terminal cockpit — high contrast, monospaced financial data, and information density that rewards experienced eyes while remaining scannable for quick glances between sessions.
keyCharacteristics: OLED-optimized dark backgrounds with subtle card elevation
Monospaced tabular numbers for all financial data
High information density with maintained readability
Animated micro-interactions (glow halos, progress rings, live ticker)

rules.name: The One Color Rule
rules.body: Each color family owns exactly one semantic meaning. Green is ONLY for gains. Red is ONLY for losses. Gold is ONLY for prop firm. Indigo is ONLY for actions.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: Never use pure gray or pure white for backgrounds. Always tint toward the brand palette.

rules.name: The Tabular Nums Rule
rules.body: Every financial number must use tabular-nums for vertical alignment.

rules.name: The Minimum 9px Rule
rules.body: No essential label falls below 9px. Body text stays at 10px minimum.

rules.name: The Glow-For-Active Rule
rules.body: Shadows with brand color appear ONLY on active/selected states.

dos: Do use fontVariant tabular-nums on every financial number
Do use semantic color families consistently
Do use mono for data, sans for UI chrome
Do add accessibilityLabel to every icon button
donts: Don't use hex colors in components — always theme.colors.*
Don't use green/red for anything other than P&L
Don't put text below 9px for essential labels
